verdict.rationale: telli is an AI voice calling platform, so DTMF keypresses, IVR navigation, and voicemail detection or drop are fair questions for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions sending DTMF tones, navigating IVR menus, or detecting or leaving voicemail. Transfer tools, retry behavior, and the six-digit email sign-in code are unrelated and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, my agent can send DTMF keypresses, navigate IVR menus, and detect or leave voicemail
